_meta.title: BRSR ↔ CDP / EcoVadis indicative crosswalk

frameworks.cdp: CDP corporate questionnaire (integrated climate / water / forests / biodiversity / plastics structure, 2024 onward)
frameworks.ecovadis: EcoVadis supplier sustainability rating — 4 themes, 21 criteria, each scored on Policies (25%), Actions (40%), Results (35%)

_meta.note: Indicative mapping of the BRSR Principle 6 (environment) disclosures to the CDP questionnaire areas and EcoVadis criteria a consultant would reuse them for. A consultant aid, not an official SEBI / CDP / EcoVadis crosswalk. Deliberately SPARSE: a row is absent where there is no clean counterpart rather than stretched to fill the grid. The vocabulary is not invented here — every cdp_area and ecovadis_criterion below is drawn verbatim from the already-sourced principle-level sets in esg_ratings_mapping.json.
_meta.scope: Principle 6 only. CDP is environmental-only, so it never reaches BRSR's workforce, human-rights, community or consumer principles; EcoVadis does, and extending this overlay to P1-P5 and P7-P9 is the obvious next increment.
_meta.known_gaps: CDP has no waste module, so waste generation/diversion/disposal carry no cdp_area. CDP's Forests area has no BRSR P6 counterpart and is therefore unused here. India-specific instruments (the PAT scheme) have no CDP equivalent. EcoVadis assesses management systems rather than scenario analysis or internal carbon pricing, so those rows carry no ecovadis_criterion.
_meta.id_convention: keyed by the framework_mappings.json brsr_id (finer-grained than brsr_data_points.json, which groups multi-part disclosures into one row)

P6-E1.cdp_detail: Purchased electricity is the activity data behind the Scope 2 figure CDP asks for
P6-E1.ecovadis_detail: Reported as a Results metric under the Energy & GHG criterion

P6-E2.cdp_detail: Fuel consumption is the activity data behind Scope 1 combustion emissions
P6-E2.ecovadis_detail: Results metric; fuel mix also evidences Actions on energy transition

P6-E3.cdp_detail: Biomass and recovered waste heat feed CDP's energy consumption breakdown
P6-E3.ecovadis_detail: Evidences Actions on energy efficiency and alternative sources

P6-E4.cdp_detail: Total energy and intensity per unit turnover align with CDP's energy and intensity metrics
P6-E4.ecovadis_detail: Intensity normalisation is what lets EcoVadis compare across suppliers

P6-E5.cdp_detail: Renewable share maps to CDP's low-carbon energy consumption question
P6-E5.ecovadis_detail: A headline Results indicator for the Energy & GHG criterion

P6-E6.ecovadis_detail: PAT compliance is usable as third-party evidence of an energy-management Action. No CDP counterpart: PAT is an India-specific instrument CDP does not ask about.

P6-E7.cdp_detail: Withdrawal by source is a core CDP water question
P6-E7.ecovadis_detail: Results metric under the Water criterion

P6-E8.cdp_detail: Consumption and intensity align with CDP's water accounting metrics
P6-E8.ecovadis_detail: Results metric; intensity supports cross-supplier comparison

P6-E9.cdp_detail: Discharge by destination and treatment level maps to CDP's discharge questions
P6-E9.ecovadis_detail: Discharge quality evidences Actions on effluent management

P6-E10.cdp_detail: ZLD is reportable as a water-management Action in CDP's water module
P6-E10.ecovadis_detail: ZLD is strong evidence of an Action preventing local water pollution

P6-E11.cdp_detail: Gross global Scope 1 emissions, a CDP core metric
P6-E11.ecovadis_detail: Headline Results metric under Energy & GHG

P6-E12.cdp_detail: Gross global Scope 2 emissions; CDP asks for both location- and market-based figures
P6-E12.ecovadis_detail: Headline Results metric under Energy & GHG

P6-E13.cdp_detail: Scope 3 by relevant category, the largest part of CDP's emissions accounting
P6-E13.ecovadis_detail: Increasingly requested by EcoVadis customers running their own value-chain accounting

P6-E14.cdp_detail: Emissions intensity, which CDP asks for alongside absolute figures
P6-E14.ecovadis_detail: Intensity is how EcoVadis normalises across supplier size

P6-E15.cdp_detail: Emissions reduction targets and progress against them sit in CDP's strategy and targets questions
P6-E15.ecovadis_detail: A published, dated target is core Policy evidence; progress is Results

P6-E16.cdp_detail: Offsets and credits are reported separately from gross emissions in CDP
P6-E16.ecovadis_detail: Treated as an Action, and never as a substitute for gross reductions

P6-E17.ecovadis_detail: Total waste by stream is the Results metric for this criterion. No cdp_area: CDP's scored modules are climate, water and forests — it has no waste module.

P6-E18.ecovadis_detail: Diversion and recovery rates evidence circularity Actions. No CDP waste module.

P6-E19.ecovadis_detail: Disposal routes (landfill, incineration) are the counterpart Results metric. No CDP waste module.

P6-E20.ecovadis_detail: NOx, SOx and particulate matter are local air-quality pollutants. No cdp_area: CDP covers greenhouse gases, not local air quality.

P6-E21.cdp_area: Identification, assessment & management of dependencies, impacts, risks & opportunities
P6-E21.cdp_detail: An EIA process is reportable as the mechanism for identifying and assessing project-level environmental impacts

P6-E22.cdp_detail: Operations in or adjacent to ecologically sensitive areas map to CDP's biodiversity area (disclosed, unscored)
P6-E22.ecovadis_detail: Site sensitivity and mitigation are the evidence base for this criterion

P6-E23.cdp_detail: Single-use plastic reduction maps to CDP's plastics area (disclosed, unscored)
P6-E23.ecovadis_detail: Packaging and single-use plastic reduction are Actions under this criterion

P6-E25.cdp_area: Identification, assessment & management of dependencies, impacts, risks & opportunities
P6-E25.cdp_detail: Identified climate risks and opportunities, with financial effect, are the substance of this CDP area
P6-E25.ecovadis_detail: Supports Policy evidence of a managed, risk-aware climate approach

P6-E26.cdp_detail: Climate scenario analysis is a named CDP strategy question. No ecovadis_criterion: EcoVadis assesses management systems rather than scenario analysis.

P6-E27.cdp_detail: Internal carbon pricing is a named CDP strategy question. No ecovadis_criterion: EcoVadis does not assess carbon pricing mechanisms.
